budget_revision_reason: Independent Rician MPS pilot and full validation projection before production; fixed531 updates to match completed Gaussian MPS benchmark, not a transferred T4 cap
success: At every sigma NGPS mean subject PSNR >= max(blindspot, adjacent); tolerance0dB
reference_limitation: Public T1 images are fixed reference signals, not demonstrated noise-free anatomy. MINC history refers to pn3_rf20 coil settings. Metrics quantify recovery of these references after added Gaussian noise, not clinical effectiveness or removal of native artifacts.
loss_convention: Course active-pixel normalized static/dynamic reconstruction and RC; RC weight0.5. Paper RC uses an unnormalized sum.
tuning: No clean-reference tuning; common configuration and fixed final epoch. No post-test changes to this protocol.
